newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares gain on good international mood.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares gain on good international mood.

text.p: 1715 GMT - Shares closed firm, boosted by the firmer European trend. Some traders said that hopes for a rate cut in Portugal and the strengthening of the dollar also helped create the positive tone.
*Portucel Industrial closed at 1,104 escudos, up 2.32 percent on hopes that international pulp prices may rise soon.
*The PSI-20 .PSI20 index ended 1.5 percent higher at 6,021.17 and traders said the mood was likely to stay buoyant on Tuesday, particularly if Wall Street remained in positive territory.

*"Tomorrow, the bourse should continue to rise although with less force than today," said one dealer, who added however, that the market was still somewhat nervous about the direction of U.S. interest rates.
